basics.name: EJ Fox
basics.label: Design Engineer & Creative Technologist
basics.summary: Design engineer and creative technologist who ships under pressure. I transform complex information into clear interactive visuals and have fun doing it. My work combines journalistic curiosity with an addiction to trying new things—from NBC’s election graphics to experimental embedding interfaces. I want to make things no one has seen before with smart, kind people. When someone hands me a mess, I take a kind of pathological joy in untangling it.

work.name: Arizona State University NEWSWELL
work.summary: The Lenfest Institute’s AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program, hosted at ASU and supported by OpenAI and Microsoft
highlights: I built a tool that uses AI to lay out the ads and stories in small local print newspapers
I gave an Ignite talk about it at ASU’s National Journalism + AI Accelerator in January 2026

work.name: Independent Consultant
work.summary: Select Clients: GitHub • NBC News • CBS News • Washington Post • New York Times • Carnegie Mellon • Stamen
highlights: I take the tight-deadline projects that need short sprints and real user testing, especially things no one has built before
I helped CBS News prototype its broadcast touchscreen app, analyzed newspaper front pages for the New York Times, and made geographic visualizations with the geniuses at Stamen.
I work between design and engineering, in whatever stack the client already has, from brand-new startups to big companies with their own process
I work in public when I can. There are 50+ Observable notebooks, plus livestreams on YouTube and blog posts about what I'm making and how.

work.name: Room 302 Studio
work.summary: Select Clients: The Associated Press • Wildlife Conservation Society • Earth Genome
highlights: My prototyping shop for new kinds of data visualization and analysis, usually on tight deadlines
I built the studio’s manager on top of an LLM. It’s our ‘AI team member’
We turn rough ideas into demos good enough for a client to show their bosses or take to a funder
I worked with the Associated Press team on its 2024 election coverage, which was nominated for a Webby.
I helped the Wildlife Conservation Society map coral reefs that are holding up against climate change and tell their story
